engineeringGuide.title: Choosing the Right Acrylic Badge Configuration
engineeringGuide.lede: Consider these four operational parameters when ordering custom acrylic badges for your organization:

factors.title: 1. Fabric & Garment Type
factors.desc: Suits, silk blazers, lab coats, or heavy sweaters.
factors.detail: For executive suits, silk blouses, and formal dresses, choose Neodymium Magnetic backings to avoid fabric pinholes. For heavy workwear or outdoor uniforms, safety pins offer physical mechanical hold.

factors.title: 2. Movement & Duty Profile
factors.desc: Sedentary boardroom vs active clinical rounds.
factors.detail: For doctors, nurses, and hospital staff who move frequently or lean over beds, triple-magnet plates provide a firm 3-point grip that prevents badge tilt or snagging.

factors.title: 3. Reusability & Staff Turnover
factors.desc: Permanent executive badges vs reusable window tags.
factors.detail: Choose direct permanent UV personalization for core executives and long-tenured staff, or reusable acrylic window inserts for seasonal retail teams.

factors.title: 4. Brand Shape & Silhouette
factors.desc: Standard rectangular name tag vs custom organic crest.
factors.detail: Take advantage of our CO2 laser cutting to match exact circular, shield, or mascot geometries rather than conforming to basic rectangular constraints.

engineeringGuide.fastenersLede: Select the right clothing attachment based on duty profile and uniform fabrics:

fasteners.title: Triple Neodymium Magnetic Plate
fasteners.desc: Three high-power N52 rare-earth magnets enclosed in a durable ABS plate with 3M VHB industrial adhesive.

fasteners.title: Stainless Steel Safety Pin
fasteners.desc: Locking stainless steel safety pin bar with molded plastic base, ideal for rugged duty or outdoor uniforms.

fasteners.title: Dual Magnet & Pin Combo Clip
fasteners.desc: All-in-one fastening system offering both a magnetic plate and a backup safety pin for multi-purpose uniform setups.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Acrylic Badges
faqs.lede: Direct answers regarding magnetic backings, custom contour shapes, minimum order quantities, and durability:

faqs.q: Will the magnetic backing damage suits or delicate clothing?
faqs.a: No! Unlike traditional pins, our neodymium magnetic plates hold firmly through blazers, lab coats, and shirts without poking holes or damaging delicate fabric fibers.

faqs.q: Can acrylic badges be cut into custom organic logo shapes?
faqs.a: Yes, our CO2 laser cutting equipment allows any custom geometric or shield shape based on your logo outline.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom acrylic badges?
faqs.a: We cater to corporate orders starting from as low as 25 pieces up to large enterprise volumes of 5,000+ units.

faqs.q: How durable is the UV printing on acrylic badges?
faqs.a: Our 1440 DPI direct UV inks are cured with industrial LED UV lamps, creating a permanent, scratch-resistant, and chemical-resistant bond on cast PMMA acrylic.

faqs.q: What is the standard production and delivery turnaround?
faqs.a: Standard orders with approved staff rosters are produced in 48–72 hours at our Guwahati facility and dispatched across Assam and all 8 Northeast states.
